recent_articles.title: Scientists just found a lost river world buried beneath Antarctica’s ice for 34 million years | World News - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An international team of researchers led by **Durham University** has discovered a vast ancient landscape beneath the East Antarctic Ice Sheet, revealing 31 flat surfaces formed by rivers that once flowed across what is now the most remote continent on Earth. The discovery was made possible by **British Antarctic Survey**'s airborne radar technology, which allowed researchers to map the bedrock beneath the ice sheet for the first time at this scale. Further exploration is needed to determine the precise influence of these ancient landscapes on past and future ice flow, including drilling to obtain rock samples from beneath the ice.
